newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Foshan Lighting 96 net rises 13.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Foshan Lighting 96 net rises 13.4 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.637 yuan vs 0.921 yuan
Net assets per share 3.87 yuan vs 5.56 yuan
Company name: Foshan Lighting and Electrical Co Ltd.

NOTE: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards except for net profits which are based on international standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the company posted net profits of 175.63 million yuan for 1996 against 169.44 million for 1995.
The firm proposed a cash payment of 0.477 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 12, it said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Friday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
